Punch Dungeon

In PUNCH DUNGEON, you have to manage your anger as you punch your way to the top of the dungeon.

Play using a gamepad or the X, C, and arrow keys. Also supports ESDF. PICO-8 cart available here.

Tip for going for max points - If your score doesn't match these values at the end of each floor you must start again.

Floor 1 - 11

Floor 2 - 24

Floor 3 - 39

Floor 4 - 56

Floor 5 - 75

Floor 6 - 96

Floor 7 - 119

And if you've done all correctly, the Throne Room should contain 20 more gems, bringing you up to 139. Hope this helps!
